summary: Phase 5.5 Controlled Testnet Hook testing complete. 46/46 pytest tests PASSED. All 10 core execution modules working correctly. Admin testnet endpoints return proper contract. Frontend /admin/futures/testnet-control renders all components correctly with testnet disabled by default and order path blocked.
critical_code_review_comments: FuturesExecutionContract: Validates symbol (USDT pairs only), side (BUY/SELL), order_type (MARKET/LIMIT), normalizes symbol to uppercase
FuturesTestnetAdapter: Wraps BinanceFuturesTestnetAdapter for submit_market_order, cancel_order, order_status, fill_status
FuturesOrderPreflight: 8 checks - symbol_active, leverage_cap, quantity_valid, reduce_only_consistency, margin_available, testnet_mode_enabled, release_gate, live_endpoint_block
FuturesRetryPolicy: TIMEOUT/RATE_LIMIT/NETWORK_ERROR/EXCHANGE_5XX are retryable; INVALID_ORDER/INSUFFICIENT_MARGIN/REDUCE_ONLY_REJECTED fail_fast; DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ORDER triggers reconcile
FuturesCancelReplaceGuard: Blocks duplicate exposure by decision_trace_id+symbol+side; reconcile_after_cancel checks if order is actually cancelled before allowing replace
FuturesReduceOnlyGuard: Validates reduce_only orders against current position - blocks if no position or would increase exposure
FuturesSlippageTracker: Calculates expected vs realized slippage in bps, tracks delta
FuturesExecutionReconciler: Maps exchange status to internal state (accepted/partially_filled/filled/cancelled/rejected/unknown_needs_reconcile)
FuturesTestnetReleaseGate: Combines live_mode_enabled, release_gate_status, has_live_credentials into final gate status - BLOCKED if any condition fails
FuturesExecutionParityCheck: Compares paper vs testnet fill prices with tolerance_bps (default 20), returns PASS or WARN
live_endpoint_access: Always FALSE - live endpoints cannot be accessed
Testnet default OFF - order path blocked until explicitly enabled

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All testnet control UI components render correctly)
